Some key points on the Tesla Cybercab from @live_munro’s production line walkthrough:

• Final assembly is about 25 fully automated stations, around 5–10x fewer than a Model Y line.
• The production line is nearly 80% automated. 
• Cybercab’s Unboxed Process uses about 50% less floor space per car.
• Right now the line runs faster than robotaxi rollout, so it doesn't run every day. 
• There is no paint shop, which Lars says saves Tesla a few hundred million dollars. Wow.
• Cybercab is built to last 500,000 miles.
• 4680 cells in separate potted modules, so a failed module can be swapped instead of the whole pack. It uses a steel enclosure (a first for Tesla) and has room for cheaper LFP cells later.
• It's FWD with an 11:1 gear ratio, since it doesn't need a high top speed. It’s new inverter is also coming to Model 3&Y this year.

patterns.label: Cold open
patterns.detail: The first line carries the whole post: a hype line ('WE ARE SO BACK', 'Omg.', 'BREAKING', 'Major breakthrough:'), a hard number ('Tesla FSD has reached 16.7 billion miles') or a question ('Why did Tesla stock just jump 6%?'). Detail comes after the line break.

patterns.label: Numbered stack / stat block
patterns.detail: Bullet stacks of hard numbers keep winning: Cybercab line (25 stations, ~80% automated, no paint shop), FSD milestones 2020 to 16.7B, geofence sizes (Miami 31, Tampa 24, Austin 272, Houston 254), FSD 9x/7x/6x fewer collisions, Raptor 4 ~30% more thrust.

patterns.label: Named tools and tickers
patterns.detail: Almost every hit names a specific thing: GPT-6.1 Terra, Fable 5.5, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Genie 4, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Muse, Axiom, Lean, Cybercab, Roadster, Ship 43, Booster 22, Raptor 4, FSD v14.3.13, $TSLA, $SPCX, Grok Bot.

patterns.label: Soft CTA
patterns.detail: Cheap closing asks: 'Am I missing something?', 'How long until the badged ones show up?', 'Do the math with millions of vehicles', 'Check your apps!', 'Do you expect the leaderboard to change much?'

patterns.label: Quote-post riding news
patterns.detail: 27 of 60 hits quote someone else's scoop (Artificial Analysis, OpenAI, Elon, ARK, @RtaxiTracker sourcing) and add one line of opinion. The top post of the day (136.9k) is a one-line quote of a teaser.

patterns.label: Media
patterns.detail: 33 photo, 18 video, 9 text-only. Charts and screenshots win for AI and Tesla numbers; owned aerial photos carry Starbase; Roadster and Cybercab sightings win on owned photos and video.

patterns.label: Timing
patterns.detail: Stars clustered Monday 9 AM to 12 PM PT (GPT-6.1 Terra launch window) and 2 PM to 6 PM PT (Cybercab, Waymo chart, Artificial Analysis teaser), with Starbase stars Monday evening 5 PM to 9 PM PT.

no_hits.reason: No original posts in the last ~24h (search for originals, no replies or reposts, returned none).

virals_narrative: Outsider AI meta (last ~48h): GPT-6.1 Terra is the topic. Small and mid accounts cleared 10k to 175k views with hands-on tests ('I tested GPT-6.1 Terra on real work. 2 repos. 105 replanted bugs.' at 174.7k) and model-vs-model tables (29.3k from a 2.2k-follower account). Fable 5.5 launch speculation lists ('Here's why' plus bullets) kept traveling, and one account got 7.6k by joking that it was not Fable day. Grok Bot content is hot: a 'spam killer inside Grok Bot' post hit 1.18M views with 12.4k likes, a Tesla Bot plus Grok voice-control how-to hit 41.1k, and 'SpaceXAI engineer says 99% use Grok Bot wrong' posts hit 20.7k and 9.9k from accounts with under 500 followers. That is Jose's lane. Dropped: CNBC (news wire, 16.1k views, 5 likes), a 460k-follower stock account (21.9k views, 46 likes), two posts with near-zero likes for their views, and watchlist accounts.
